document.title: Skill: batch workflow commands and drop the schema read
document.summary: The next skill batches shell calls, uses example.md as the shape reference, lists validate checks, and writes review.json once. Lockfile excludes come from the covering `--stat`. Eval skips the npm version check without pinning it to step 1, and records producer steps and tool calls.
document.why: [#96](source:s1) asks for skill-only token efficiency: batch the producer commands, drop the schema read, and name what validate checks.

sources.title: Skill: batch the workflow commands, drop the schema read, name what validate checks

commits.subject: Drop canned lockfile names from the covering diff step.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Step 3 still excludes lockfiles that appear in the covering --stat.
The skill no longer lists ecosystem filenames that agents might exclude
from every repo.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Name the commit source label as the git subject or SHA.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Eval fails when a producer truncates that label with an ellipsis.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Exclude only lockfiles from the covering change.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Step 3 takes lockfile paths from git diff --stat instead of always
excluding a fixed list of lockfile names.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Record producer steps and stop pinning the version skip to step 1.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The skill now resolves refs in step 1, so the eval prompt skips the npm
version check without a step number. Agent runs also count LLM steps and
tool calls for token-efficiency measurement.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Batch skill workflow commands and drop the schema pointer.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The producer now runs npm view, review, git log, and git diff --stat in one
shell call, then the covering diff with lockfiles excluded plus source reads
in the next round trip. example.md is the shape reference, validate lists
its checks, lockfiles have no hunk refs, and review.json is written once.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
